discovery.description: Resolve a Pennsylvania business name to one strong registry entity and compare its Department of State creation date with a caller-selected minimum age. Returns established_entity, recent_entity, company_not_found, or human_review. Formation age alone does not establish current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether a uniquely resolved Pennsylvania business entity is at least a caller-selected age using Pennsylvania Department of State creation-date evidence. Returns established_entity, recent_entity, company_not_found, or human_review. Formation age is an identity/history signal, not proof of current good standing, ownership, authority, legitimacy, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance.

buyer.task: Determine whether a uniquely resolved Pennsylvania business entity is at least a caller-selected age from its Department of State creation date.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independent settled purchases and repeat buyers per product after launch; do not infer demand from tests or crawler probes.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live registry lookup on each paid request

rules: Require a uniquely resolved strong Pennsylvania registry entity.
Require a valid creation date that is not in the future.
Return company_not_found when the registry lookup succeeds but no entity is found.
Return established_entity when the creation date is on or before the minimum-age cutoff; return recent_entity when newer; otherwise return human_review.

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; caller should retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Release gate passes from the same registry revision.
Authoritative live-source smoke passes without source failures.
Shared non-credit-gated hosting is available and measured.
Post-allowance unit economics are settlement-negative at the current price; commercial promotion remains blocked until economics are repaired or an explicit exception is approved.
